name: Core 40
description: 40 varied shots for a character LoRA dataset: 10 close-ups, 15 half-body, 15 full-body. Different angles, expressions, outfits, places and light. Captions describe everything EXCEPT her face and hair, so the LoRA learns the face as the trigger word.
